name: Quality Analytics and Management
description: Practising engineers play a vital role in ensuring the success of sustained generation of quality goods and services, which hinges on not just technology, which changes rapidly with time, but also operational excellence. This course brings out proven strategic approaches and practical techniques essential for quality of products and operational competitiveness in the complex and changing world. The insights and knowledge gained are also useful for students wishing to acquire professional certification after completion of the course.
